title.description: The main name of the book. This is the primary label readers, catalogs, and exported files use to identify the work.

subtitle.description: A secondary line that adds context, tone, or a clarifying phrase to the title.
subtitle.example: Pocket-sized catastrophe management for the holidays

author.description: The person, collective, or organization responsible for the work. Use this for credited creators and contributors.

pubDate.description: The publishing or release date associated with this edition. It helps with citations, export metadata, and edition tracking.

publisher.description: The press, imprint, label, or organization that published the book.

language.description: The primary language used in the book's content.

region.description: A regional locale code that refines the language when that matters for cataloging or export metadata.

subject.description: A short human-readable topic or category phrase. This is useful for export metadata when you want a plain-language subject line.

description.description: A brief summary, blurb, or catalog note explaining what the book is about.
description.example: A tiny handbook of festive corners cut, avoidable accidents, and cheerful workplace dread.

keywords.description: Search-friendly words or phrases that help describe the book in exports and future discovery tools. Separate terms with commas.

classification.description: The shelving or taxonomy code used to place the book within your classification system.

cityPublished.description: The city associated with publication or release. Useful for formal colophons and bibliographic records.

copyright.description: A short copyright statement for this edition.

isbn.description: A 10-digit International Standard Book Number, usually used for older editions.

isbn13.description: A 13-digit International Standard Book Number used by modern publishing workflows and retailers.

edition.description: A note naming the edition or release state of the book.

phone.description: A phone number connected to the publisher, imprint, or contact line listed in the book.

website.description: A publisher, author, or project website related to the book.

address.description: A mailing or business address for the publisher, imprint, or contact block.
address.example:
123 Little Press Lane
Saint Paul, MN 55101

email.description: An email address for the publisher, author, or contact block.

copyrightNotice.description: A fuller legal or rights statement that can be placed on the copyright page.
copyrightNotice.example: No part of this publication may be reproduced without prior written permission, except for brief quotations in reviews.

creditsDisclaimer.description: A note for contributor credits, acknowledgments, content warnings, or disclaimers.
creditsDisclaimer.example: Names have been changed, rumors remain unverified, and every typo belongs to the editor.

seriesName.description: The name of the series this book belongs to, if any.

number.description: The numbered position of the book within a series or sequence.

volume.description: The volume designation for a multi-volume work.

printing.description: A note describing the printing state of this physical release.

custom.description: A flexible field for anything not covered by the built-in book info fields.
